tagline: A developer, occasionally a human being.
summaryParagraphs: Hey — I'm Antoni Saputra, though most people know me as Lixu :). By day I work as a front-end engineer; outside of that I build things for fun and try to document the journey here.
Most of my time goes into the React ecosystem — shipping product, integrating APIs, and keeping the front end from falling apart.
I'm drawn to software that's built with genuine care for the people who use it.

quote.body: Programs must be written for people to read, and only incidentally for machines to execute.
quote.citation: Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs

segments.text: — designing and shipping client websites and web apps.
— reading more, thinking more, shipping more.
new things in the world of programming
— learning, experimenting, and growing along the way.
Writing it all down as I go.

bullets: Built and maintained features across Logika Data's products, including POS and ERP systems, with Zenenta (zenenta.com) as one of them, using React.js, Next.js and TypeScript.
Implemented pixel-perfect, responsive interfaces from Figma designs.
Managed client state with Zustand and server state with TanStack Query, covering data fetching, caching, mutations and loading/error handling.
Integrated REST APIs and translated complex business workflows into clean, typed, maintainable components.
Contributed to the marketplace project across the frontend and backend.
Managed VPS servers and CI/CD pipelines, deploying containerized services with Docker.
Worked in a team using Git feature branching, pull requests and code review.
Built the frontend of a paid WiFi sales platform with Next.js, using responsive design and modern React patterns.
Migrated the application to the latest Next.js version, improving SSR/SSG compatibility, performance and maintainability.
Design and develop responsive client websites and web applications with React, Next.js and Vue.js/Nuxt.
Handle state with Zustand (React) and Pinia (Vue), and manage API and server data with TanStack Query.
Integrate frontends with Supabase backend services, handling asynchronous data and API calls.
Own the full project lifecycle from design to deployment, following clean code standards and collaborative Git workflows.
Contributed to a marketplace project with Next.js (frontend) and Golang (backend), implementing features across the stack.
Resolved issues on a procurement system in a team environment using Git-based workflows.
Gained hands-on experience with the SDLC, asynchronous data handling and professional engineering practices.
